name: Nscale
description: Nscale is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors, funds and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Nscale is a privately held AI cloud company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent equity round, a $2 billion Series C announced on March 9, 2026, valued the company at $14.6 billion.

Founded in 2024 and based in London, Nscale builds data centers and operates GPU clusters that supply computing capacity for training and running AI models. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Nscale
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company, except the Series B valuation, which the company did not disclose; no valuation was disclosed for the Series A. The Series C amount includes an earlier pre-Series C SAFE.
round_notes: In September 2026, Nscale announced $3.36 billion of convertible loan notes led by Third Point, which convert into ordinary shares when the company completes an initial public offering. Nscale filed a registration statement with the SEC on September 18, 2026 for a proposed listing on the New York Stock Exchange and amended it on November 12, 2026; no offering price had been set as of November 19, 2026.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Aker ASA and 8090 Industries led the Series C, with participation from Nvidia, Dell, Nokia, Lenovo, Citadel, Jane Street, Point72, Linden Advisors and Astra Capital Management. Aker ASA also led the Series B, and Sandton Capital Partners led the Series A. Other investors include Blue Owl, Fidelity, G Squared and T.Capital.
spv_sentence: Since 2024, six special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Nscale have filed with the SEC, four of them in 2026.
funds: Mutual funds managed by Fidelity reported holdings of Nscale preferred stock in filings for periods in 2026.
sources: Sources: Nscale's announcements of its Series C, Series B and convertible financing; Nscale's Form S-1; reports by SiliconANGLE (December 2024) and CNBC (November 2026); and SEC Form D and Form N-PORT filings.
